title: Dashboard manifest
description: Freshness and provenance metadata published by each dashboard at /<repo>/manifest.json. The hub reads these to show last-updated and data-vintage badges per card.

lastBuild.description: ISO date the dashboard HTML was last regenerated/edited

name.description: Source name, e.g. 'Dept of Education Higher Education Statistics'

vintage.description: What the data covers, e.g. 'to 2024', '2025 + 2026 snapshots', 'QS 2026 edition'

refreshed.description: When this source was last pulled

notes.description: Caveats worth surfacing on the hub, e.g. definitional breaks
